title: Validity of a Reissued Pals Rewards Certificate — Ledger Computation
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus — validity of a certificate reissued after the order it was used on is refunded on return.**

**Value.** The certificate is reissued at its certificate value — $5.00 on every tier.

**Validity.** The reissue validity is the certificate validity days of the tier held, counted in calendar days with the reissue date as day 1. The reissue validity granted is the days produced by its method plus every extension added to it, as a whole number of days; the days produced by its method are the certificate validity days of the tier held.

| Tier held | Reissue validity (calendar days, reissue date as day 1) |
|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Member | 30 |
| Pals Rewards Insider | 30 |
| Pals Rewards VIP | 45 |
| Tailwise Plus Monthly | 45 |
| Tailwise Plus Annual | 45 |
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | 60 |

**Last usable day (hypothetical dates).** A certificate reissued on 1 March with 60 days is usable through 29 April: 1 March is day 1, 31 March is day 31 and 29 April is day 60. Reissued on 1 March with 45 days, it is usable through 14 April.
